parsed.internal_thinking: I have placed my settlement on node 20, which gives me access to Brick (6), Sheep (8), and Wood (11). Now I need to place a road. Looking at the path analysis, building towards node 10 is the strongest move. Node 10 itself is not buildable (too close), but it leads to node 11 (Brick 6, Sheep 5, Wood 12 - 10 pips) and node 9 (3:1 port). Node 11 also connects to node 12 (Brick 6, Sheep 5, Wood 3 - 11 pips). This cluster is excellent for securing high-probability tiles. Building toward 19 leads only to 8-pip spots, and 21 is even weaker. I will place the road from 20 to 10.
parsed.note_to_self: Building towards nodes 11 and 12 to double down on high-probability Brick (6) and Sheep (5). This path also opens up a 3:1 port at node 9.
